label: late original-phase / <DEL> steps in sequences starting with p or a, on inputs n,x,u,i,h,g,2,e
explanation: Fires only in the original phase at t>=3 (67% of mass) and on the <DEL> step (33%); never in the copy phase or at t<3. Rate rises with orig position and with L. Two factors combine conjunctively: the first original token (p 8x, a 7x, k 3x lift; 62% of mass in p/a-initial sequences) and the current input (n, <DEL>, x, u, i, h, g, 2 strongly elevated; l, o, v, w suppressed), almost always on a first occurrence of the input token (94% of mass). The conjunction reaches only F1 ~0.45 / mass recall ~0.56: many activations occur in sequences with other first tokens, and many p/a-initial steps on the listed inputs stay inactive, so the unit looks like a graded readout of hidden state (first-token memory x current input) rather than a crisp category. Top activations are p/a-initial sequences at the last original steps or <DEL>.
